review_type: Source strips, final transparent previews, frame inspection, and desktop/mobile preview

states.idle: Heavy inhale and sag, two consecutive dark-eye frames, reluctant relight; planted feet.
states.running-right: Heel-first screen-right trudge, limp arms, alternating gait and two dark-eye frames.
states.running-left: Independently generated left trudge with screen-fixed lighting and two dark-eye frames.
states.waving: Half acknowledgment becomes a dismissive palm rotation and limp wrist, then arm drops; dark eyes held.
states.jumping: Deep crouch, brief reluctant hop with dark eyes at apex/descent, heavy landing; both feet rise.
states.failed: Both palms cover forehead/visor; double facepalm held across frames 2-5 with bowed head and knees; hands release before relight.
states.waiting: Broad palms-up shrug, raised elbows, two head tilts and dark eyes; one palm waits before arms drop.
states.running: Head sags into temple hand, opposite hand taps/counts impatiently near chest, two dark-eye frames.
states.review: Slow index point, held through frames 1-4, narrow green lenses, alternating head yaw right-left-right in frames 2-4; lights off as arm lowers in frame 5.

registration: Shared 0.87 scale for non-jump rows, native extracted jump displacement; planted-foot midpoint anchors stationary rows.
cleanup: Final sheet received one chroma-edge cleanup pass; preserved look cells match original final pixels.
blind_review_followup: Vertical pair 6 was reinspected by all three reviewers as an isolated crop after the tall sheet appeared blank to them; all independently confirmed up/down. Four unchanged near-vertical horizontal ambiguities were reviewed in the full arc.
